suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document Stop() goroutine-join semantics in the bounded runtime test procedure: Stop() waits for the handler goroutine to exit. Workers writing stop-related tests should use non-blocking channel synchronization (handler signals via channel close/send, test reads to confirm runtime is alive, then calls Stop concurrently). Blocking handlers that wait on Stop() will deadlock.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature misc-test-nits (Fix 2) encountered this: worker tried a blocking handler approach, which caused Stop() to hang because it waits for the handler goroutine to exit. Worker had to iterate to find the correct channel-based approach.
